slideshow.title: From doing the task to running the factory
slideshow.description: Six hand-drawn sketches on how AI agents change knowledge work: from waiting on one person to running a line of agents, what starts an agent, the agent loop, prompts and skills, and the software factory.

slides.title: Today: a line of agents waits on one person
The future: agents run the line while you design it
What starts an agent: a schedule, a webhook, an incident, feedback, a bug hunt, or another agent
The agent loop: trigger, agent works, check, repeat
Prompts and skills: turn a repeated task into a reusable skill
From agentic loop to software factory: many loops chained together
